description: Three violet caps on one root, the big one freckled pale. Turn it over before you pay for it.
lore: Everything you are buying is on the underside. Grown in ground, the base comes up dished and full of grit. Grown on an animal — on wet moss over a shoulder that has not moved through several winters — it comes up flat, and the stems all lean one way, downhill from where the withers were. Flat is worth triple. Flat also means the picker stood near enough to a [[monsters/swamp_bear|Mireback]] to take three caps off it, which is a thing a person is entitled to be proud of, and is far more often a thing a person did at home with a board and a heavy stone. Buyers know. Sellers know they know. The haggling is two people agreeing not to say so.
gm_notes: A forger's tell and the courtesy around it. Good for teaching players that junk is graded by evidence of where it grew, not by the thing itself.
